stage0026_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Um... do you like '《$$アクエリアの舞う空$$》'?」

stage0026_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Well... I saw you crying during the last scene...」

stage0026_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Oh, um... me!
　I work at the theater you were just at!」

stage0026_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Well! Playing an old movie like
　'《$$アクエリアの舞う空$$》' is only because I
　begged the manager to let me!」

stage0026_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even the manager says it's weird!
　He says the only good part of that movie
　is $$アリシア$$, who plays the heroine $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0026_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「B-but, when I watch that... watch $$アリシア$$...
　I feel like just letting fate go by
　isn't enough... that's what I think!」

stage0026_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...I'm sorry.
　This was actually my first time seeing it...」

stage0026_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Um...!
　Could you tell me your name?
　If you don't mind...」

stage0026_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...If you don't mind, want to talk for a bit?」

stage0026_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I wanted to hear about '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...」

stage0026_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「If you still have work to do,
　I don't mind waiting.」

stage0026_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'll keep waiting for you...
　Even for ten thousand and two thousand years...」

stage0026_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah... that's a line from 'Skies of Aquaria'...」

stage0026_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...Or so I said, already copying the line.」

stage0026_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Oh, no...! This is bad, if this keeps up...!
　My body's...）

stage0026_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「S-sorry!
　This cat's name is $$シュシュ$$.
　It likes sitting on my head, I think...」

stage0026_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Hey... tell me about the movie.」

stage0026_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Oh... right...!
　'$$アクエリアの舞う空$$' is based on the legend
　of an ancient war against the $$堕天翅$$.」

stage0026_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's that fairy tale from 12,000 years ago, right?」

stage0026_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The movie didn't get great reviews,
　but the theme song won an award at a festival.」

stage0026_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「That song... it was really good!
　The singer was $$アリシア$$, who played $$シルフィ$$, right?」

stage0026_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Her acting's great too, such a good vibe.
　I can't believe there's an actress that pretty.」

stage0026_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah... she is pretty.
　Almost cruelly so...」

stage0026_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Oh, that reminds me, $$ミコノ$$...
　Is this your first time in this town?」

stage0026_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah.
　Though the Abductors are a bit scary...」

stage0026_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The mysterious enemy from another dimension,
　the Abductors...」

stage0026_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But staying shut inside all the time is a waste,
　I should get some sun once in a while.」

stage0026_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Heh... people say I'm simple-minded a lot.」

stage0026_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But the news said today that Abductors
　showed up in some town again...」

stage0026_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...Seems like it.
　Aquarion drives them off, but it never ends.」

stage0026_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Hey, $$アマタ$$... did you know?
　There's a school somewhere in the world that trains
　Elements... Aquarion pilots, I mean.」

stage0026_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The robot that fights the Abductors,
　Aquarion, huh...」

stage0026_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「At that school,
　only kids with the special power to be chosen
　by Aquarion can enroll.」

stage0026_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Like $$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$...」

stage0026_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The two who saved the world 12,000 years ago...」

stage0026_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Hey, $$アマタ$$, do you ever want to pilot Aquarion?」

stage0026_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...Guess I've thought that before...
　But there's no way someone like me gets chosen,
　and there's no way someone like me could do it...」

stage0026_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah, me too.
　There's no way someone like me could do it.
　We're both hopeless cases, huh.」

stage0026_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Did you protect me, $$アマタ$$...?」

stage0026_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Though we both ended up pinned under the rubble...」

stage0026_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's fine, a wound on my body...
　is a lot better than a wound on my heart...」

stage0026_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（This is bad...
　At this rate, we'll both be crushed...）

stage0026_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Huh...?
　Sorry for what, $$アマタ$$...?」

stage0026_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I want to protect you...! Protect $$ミコノ$$...!
　That's why, I'm sorry!」

stage0026_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I've never felt this before...!
　Aaah...! I'm coming apart...!」

stage0026_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Everything I knew, everything I felt,
　it's all coming apart...!」

stage0026_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Bursting...! Something I've held dear
　all this time is bursting open...!」

stage0026_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「A wedding in mourning clothes...!
　The nightmare I once saw!」

stage0026_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ドナール$$
「The Element ability, Despair Foresight...!
　It visualizes ominous events yet to come!」

stage0026_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Why can we all see that vision!?」

stage0026_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$学園長$$
「It's Aquarion...
　Aquarion, having reclaimed
　its forbidden name, shows us this...!」

stage0026_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カイエン$$
「So this is what the foresight meant...!
　The worst, most hopeless combination...!」

stage0026_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Me? Why would it be me...?」

stage0026_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Who's the man she's marrying!
　Show your face!」

stage0026_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Combining with Vector Zed as the head...
　I never knew Aquaria had another form...」

stage0026_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ドナール$$
「The male female combination was
　supposed to be blocked by the Guize Stone...!」

stage0026_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$学園長$$
「The seal has been broken...
　By those boys' own hands...」

stage0026_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$学園長$$
「...Unlike today's Aquaria, split into
　male and female, it's one being with
　both sexes... complete in itself...」

stage0026_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But no human can truly wield
　a tool of the gods...」

stage0026_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$学園長$$
「Never mind that, confirm the situation」

stage0026_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Panic seems to be spreading among
　the academy's students as well」

stage0026_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Damn it...!
　Who'd have thought the whole academy
　would get caught in a $$時空震動$$...!」

stage0026_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$学園長$$
「Chairwoman! You've come here after all!」

stage0026_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「This latest $$時空震動$$... how do you read it?」

stage0026_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「We should consider them a factor too.
　It's too well arranged to be chance」

stage0026_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「But this is an accident.
　It goes unmentioned even in
　the Apocrypha of the Dead Sea Scrolls」

stage0026_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「The outcome will not change.
　At most, the schedule sees some effect」

stage0026_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「The Human Instrumentality Project...
　Everything proceeds as scheduled」

stage0026_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Understood.
　Everything will proceed according to $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s scenario」

stage0026_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Miss $$スズネ$$?
　Did $n act selfish again?」

stage0026_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, another round of listening to
　you vent, as always? But Miss $$スズネ$$,
　you're a different person once you drink」

stage0026_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just the other day, you suddenly
　started taking your clothes off...」

stage0026_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I never did anything like that!」

stage0026_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding.
　You looked so troubled, so I pulled out
　a Dimension Joke to help you relax」

stage0026_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A Dimension Joke... so those
　really exist, huh...」

stage0026_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also known as a Subspace Joke.
　No setup, no context, no foreshadowing,
　just a random joke made up on the spot」

stage0026_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, please don't recoil!
　Wasn't there something you needed from me?」

stage0026_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I wanted to ask you something.
　Is there anything I can do besides
　being $$ジェニオン$$'s navigator?」

stage0026_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I want to be of some help to $n...」

stage0026_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My my, Miss $$スズネ$$ is such a good person!
　Honestly, you're far too good
　a partner for $n!」

stage0026_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But being this devoted goes beyond
　just a student and teacher relationship...
　So how does that work, exactly?」

stage0026_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ooooh! How mysterious!
　I just can't get enough of this!」

stage0026_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. Then in addition to
　sensors and output control, let's have
　you handle weapons fire control too」

stage0026_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As for how it's done,
　I'll prepare my own special manual」

stage0026_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, so as not to be outdone
　by Miss $$スズネ$$, I'll dive in today too...
　Business, business!」
